title: LOINC 2.83: subset of the official LOINC Table
parent: every LOINC Part on the term's paths to the root of the ComponentHierarchyBySystem (hierarchy); terms are leaves

map_to_rows.rule: official rows whose LOINC and MAP_TO codes are both in the pack, unchanged; rows naming a code excluded for its EXTERNAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE are dropped

hierarchy.title: LOINC 2.83 ComponentHierarchyBySystem (multiaxial hierarchy), the rows of the pack's terms and of their Parts
hierarchy.rule: official rows of the LOINC terms in the pack and of the LOINC Parts on their paths to the root, unchanged; rows of terms excluded for their EXTERNAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE and of Parts on no kept term's path (most have no term below them) are dropped

license: LOINC license, full text in LoincLicense_5.8.txt (http://loinc.org/license), unchanged. Field names and contents are those of the official LOINC Table, unchanged; records with an EXTERNAL_COPYRIGHT_NOTICE are excluded (Section 10.2); MapTo.csv keeps the official rows whose two codes are both in the pack, unchanged, so every code comes with its LONG_COMMON_NAME (Section 10.3). The hierarchy keeps the official ComponentHierarchyBySystem rows of the pack's terms and of the Parts on their paths, unchanged and with every column, so the hierarchy is used as presented in the LOINC distribution (Section 5), every Part number comes with its Part name and every term with its short name (Section 10.3), and the fields that give the rows their meaning are kept (Section 10.6).
